comment: Carried GNUstep patches for the patch layer. Protocol: docs/carried-patches/README.md. Each base lists its patches in apply order; paths are relative to this directory. outputs: the installed files a base's rebuild contributes to the layer (glob patterns); every other file the rebuild changes is reported, not shipped.
